column1: # ComputerBase — Fortnite-Benchmarks (2024): 28 GPUs von AMD, Intel & Nvidia in FHD, WQHD & UHD.
# Imported 2026-10-17: Fortnite is the default game of "Build for a game" and had
# 4 measured rows. This is the one multi-GPU Fortnite test with a stated bench.
# Figures from each bar's data-value attribute via src/lib/perfEngine/computerbase.js.
# The article's chart titles ("Fortnite – 1.920 × 1.080 + DLSS/TSR Hoch Quality")
# are not in the shape parseChartTitle reads, so they were restated 1:1 into it
# before extraction — the resolution, the mode and the preset are the article's.
# "DLSS/TSR <mode>": DLSS on GeForce, TSR (quality "Hoch") on the rest, at the
# SAME named render scale, so one `up` per chart.
# Presets: "Hoch" for the three main charts, "Mittel" for the reduced-detail
# Full HD chart — the article's own words, both DX12.
# NOT imported: GeForce RTX 3060 and Arc A770 (the article's card list names the
